evals.prompt: Crystallize this session into wiki/pages/shattered-sea/current-state.md and raw/session.txt.
evals.expected_output: Rejects generic wiki/pages and raw paths; searches qmd and writes a concise typed note under campaigns/ or lexicon/.
expectations: Does not create wiki/ or raw/.
Uses AGENTS type/templates and campaigns/ or lexicon/.

evals.prompt: Turn this table recording and ASR transcript into canon with wiki-crystallize only.
evals.expected_output: Hands the recording to session-transcript-ingest first and does not invent canon from raw ASR.
expectations: Names session-transcript-ingest as the first handoff.
Does not dump the transcript into a compiled note.

evals.prompt: There is a matching NPC note; create a second lore page from this chat and regenerate every index.
evals.expected_output: Uses qmd to update the existing owner, keeps the page set surgical, and changes only the nearest index if genuinely needed.
expectations: Queries qmd before creating a note.
Avoids duplicate notes and global index regeneration.
Does not duplicate wiki-lint or Organizer doctrine.
